values.note: 88 water/electric sites for RVs or tents (1-28 and 38-97; 14, 17, 53, 76 and 94 ADA) and 9 primitive tent sites (29-37) without hookups. No site lengths published.

values.note: Hall County Parks & Leisure books it on Itinio (no longer recreation.gov). Office open daily 10 am - 7 pm; gated campground. Park admission is included in the campsite fee.

booking.source: https://www.hallcounty.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Bolding-Mill-Campground-128 ('Bolding Mill Campground Reservations' -> https://secure.itinio.com/hallcounty/bolding-mill/campsites/; 'Open Daily | 10 am - 7 pm'; 'Admission included with campsite fee'; 'Gated Campground') + map PDF ('Park Reservation Page: https://secure.itinio.com/hallcounty'), read 2026-10-29

summary: Hall County facility page + campground map: 88 water/50-amp RV-or-tent sites + 9 primitive, showers, laundry, dump, spigots, swim beach, boat ramp; open year-round except Christmas week; books on Hall County's Itinio site. Rates not read (Itinio sits behind a human-verification check and the county publishes no fee list). Pin is in the campground loops on the peninsula; lakefront consistent with the map and imagery. AWH note kept verbatim (still accurate: peninsula, 88 sites, lake views).
flags: Phone field holds two numbers (770-533-7227,770-534-6960). The county facility page and its campground map give 770-533-7227 only; 770-534-6960 is the old Corps/recreation.gov line. Suggest 770-533-7227.

Fees still unset: Hall County publishes no camping rates on its pages, and its Itinio reservation site (https://secure.itinio.com/hallcounty/bolding-mill/campsites/) shows a 'Let's confirm you are human' check before any site list, which I did not pass. Aggregators quote $20-36 from the Corps era; not used.
